chunks: Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān asked him and said to him:
"I reach the morning having missed the Witr until the night; so how should I make it up?" He said: "Like for like."

key_terms.أَقْضِي: I perform as qaḍāʾ, making up a missed act of worship
key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the Witr prayer of the night prayer
key_terms.مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ: in a corresponding manner, like for like

ai.seo_question: How should the missed Witr prayer be made up according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the qaḍāʾ of the Witr prayer when it has been missed until nighttime. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that it be made up correspondingly, indicating a like-for-like manner in its qaḍāʾ.
